page.overview:
Who is Fabrizio del Monte?

Fabrizio del Monte (born 5 December 1980) is a Italian race car driver.

He said he had secured Midland's third driver seat for the 2006 San Marino Grand Prix, but this fell through due to lack of sponsorship. His place was taken by Giorgio Mondini. del Monte was also to be the team's third driver in the 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix.
